text: Task 4 — Sorting Objects by Color A robotic sorting system receives an image containing objects of different colors. The robot is interested only in one particular colored object and needs a binary mask identifying that object. Intensity alone cannot reliably distinguish the desired object from the background. Your Task Use a color image containing a clearly distinguishable colored object, such as the yellow-car example: Build a color-based segmentation system. Your 1. 2. 3. 4. 5. 6. program must: Load the image in color. Convert it to HSV. Define a lower and upper color range . Generate a binary mask using the color range. Experiment with the lower and upper limits. Extract the selected color from the original image using your mask. Challenge Requirement Create two masks: • A mask that is too restrictive A final mask that captures the desired object more completely Then explain why the restrictive mask fails. The manual specifically presents HSV-based color thresholding using lower and upper bounds. Talha Shahid 4 Page
